summary: Frontend-only testing of searchable Combobox for Role and Office on User create & edit forms. All specified flows passed: role/office popover opens with search input, filtering works, selection updates trigger label, create user succeeds, edit page pre-selects current role/office values, changing role via search saves correctly, and no regressions on other fields. Test user was created and cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: Combobox uses CommandItem `value={o.label}` for cmdk filtering — works when labels are unique; if two roles/offices share the same label, filtering/selection can collide. Consider using a unique key like `${o.value}::${o.label}` combined with a keywords prop.

UserFormPage.jsx still imports shadcn Select components (Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue) even though they are no longer used — dead imports should be removed to keep bundle clean.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Combobox User (test.combo.<timestamp>@example.com) and deleted after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Combobox trigger uses data-testid='user-field-role' and 'user-field-office'; search input inside popover has placeholder 'Search role...'/'Search office...'; items are [cmdk-item]. Edit route: /users/:id/edit; row action ellipsis triggers menu with Edit/Delete via data-testid users-row-actions-<id>.
